signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.withProvider: Sign in with an account of one of these services:
signIn.firstTime: Reliquary makes your account at the first sign-in. It keeps your email address and your name from the service, and no password.
signIn.noMethod: This instance has no sign-in service. The administrator must add the settings of Google, GitHub or Discord.

development.title: Development sign-in
development.description: This instance is a development instance. You can open an account with no external service. Do not put real data on this instance.
development.email: Email address of a test account
development.emailHint: Reliquary makes the account when it does not exist.
